title: Learning to Act While Waiting: RL Finetuning of Generalist Robot Policies Under Inference Latency
abstract: arXiv:2608.23831v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While reinforcement learning (RL) allows generalist robot policies to continually improve during deployment, the large model size of modern generalist policies, such as VLAs, poses a fundamental obstacle to effective RL improvement. In particular, their severe inference latency---which can lead to pauses or jerky movements---can alter the effective environment dynamics and, if not correctly accounted for, break the Markov assumption that RL relies on, causing standard RL algorithms to fail completely. In this work, we introduce a latency-aware framework, Asynchronous RL with Intermediate Information (ARLI), that enables RL-based improvement of generalist policies under inference delays. translated_title: 在等待中学习行动：推理延迟下通用机器人策略的强化学习微调
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23831v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：虽然强化学习（RL）允许通用机器人策略在部署过程中持续改进，但现代通用策略（如VLA）的大模型规模对有效的RL改进构成了根本性障碍。特别是，它们严重的推理延迟——可能导致停顿或抖动运动——会改变有效环境动态，如果处理不当，会破坏RL所依赖的马尔可夫假设，导致标准RL算法完全失效。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个延迟感知框架，即异步RL与中间信息（ARLI），该框架能够在推理延迟下实现基于RL的通用策略改进。我们的框架建立在异步推理方法之上，这些方法通过交错动作生成与执行来隐藏延迟，并通过提供低延迟RL策略设计来解决其与RL的不兼容性，该设计在推理过程中最大化响应性。
tldr: 本文提出一种延迟感知的异步RL框架（ARLI），通过交错动作生成与执行并利用中间信息，使通用机器人策略在推理延迟下仍能有效进行强化学习微调。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a latency-aware asynchronous RL framework (ARLI) that interleaves action generation with execution and leverages intermediate information, enabling effective RL finetuning of generalist robot policies under inference latency.
